Canadian Championship Soccer Matches Conclude

Two Canadian soccer teams, Hamilton Forge and CF Montreal, have advanced to the Canadian Championship final. Hamilton Forge defeated Supra du Quebec with a score of 1-0. CF Montreal secured their spot by topping the reigning champions, Whitecaps. The specific details of the Whitecaps match score were not provided in the coverage.
